observations: The official 6.11 index lists 6.11.2 and the official 6.12 index lists 6.12.0 on 2026-10-16. Qt 6.12.0 is a released update, but is not a complete remediation candidate.

The peeled v6.12.0 tag identifies qtbase commit 025bdad181de241e81bf853c8a2d7bf3d19261a9. Its PCRE2 attribution says 10.48; its JIT source still has the unconditional fixed-growth resize stub and lacks the large-allocation handling from 2b4038298072684b0fae29b15bedfb1a75bda46d.

Qt 6.12.0 gzwrite.c is byte-identical to Qt 6.11.2 gzwrite.c and retains the failed-write return without the avail_in/next_in resets in df84af25dc1942490e1d1c899a07619152a46148. A version label alone was not used to infer patch status.
The frozen 10.47 partial-JIT allocation counterexample and x86_64 growable-stack evidence from v1 remain valid. No successful ordinary match is substituted for either missing proof.
F-OFFICIAL-QT.requiredReleaseContent: An official Qt release incorporating PCRE2 10.49 or the applicable upstream fixes, including the large-stack fix, and the native zlib failed-write state-reset fix. Upstream changes shipped by Qt qualify; a BPR-maintained patch does not.
F-OFFICIAL-QT.requiredQualification: Upgrade provider/source pins together only after an eligible release exists; use existing release package paths; bind exact delivered Mac/Windows payloads, source offers, SPDX and inventory; run relevant dependency/package/public-path checks and unsuppressed fresh vulnerability reports. A source-only check is not package acceptance.

F-DBUS.status: technical-gap-resolved; narrow applicability proposal supported; independent follow-up review and security-owner acceptance pending
F-DBUS.rationale: QtGui links QtDBus and contains QDesktopUnixServices, so framework presence alone is not dismissed. The shipped Cocoa integration selects QCocoaServices, derived directly from QPlatformServices, and uses Apple services. Generic Unix theme/menu/tray/portal constructors are excluded on this Mac build; Xcb, Wayland, VNC and external platform-theme plugins are absent from the bound package. No first-party, QtNetwork, QtWidgets or shipped Cocoa/style/network/TLS plugin D-Bus consumer was found. QtDBus resolves external libdbus lazily. Both exact-package initialization probes loaded QtDBus but no external libdbus; an explicit harmless marker load tested the detector. Together these support exclusion of the vulnerable external parser in the inspected packaged Cocoa composition.
F-DBUS.limits: This is a source-backed applicability inference plus an automatic-initialization probe, not a trace of an active GUI session, native Intel qualification, Linux/Windows evidence or a claim that arbitrary third-party D-Bus installations are patched. Reopen for changed plugins/platform selection, first-party D-Bus usage, Qt source/build options or package bytes.

F-APPLE.status: vendor-patched hypothesis rejected on tested host; complete delivered-closure applicability remains pending
observations: macOS 26.6.2 (25G83), both arm64 and Rosetta x86_64, exports crc32_combine and crc32_combine_gen from /usr/lib/libz.1.dylib. Passing -1 timed out at two seconds in all four API/architecture cases. Lengths 0 and 1 returned promptly. Neither crc32_combine64 nor crc32_combine_gen64 is exported; absence of the 64-suffixed symbols does not exclude the aliases.

The published Apple distribution tags map 26 OS releases, macos-130 through macos-265, to eight zlib revisions. macOS 13 source uses an older nonpositive-length guard. The inspected macOS 14, 15 and 26 source revisions lack the new guard; the exported unsuffixed aliases reach the affected implementation. These are vendor source mappings, not executions of each OS or a source-to-binary assertion for unpublished 26.6.2.

All 14 delivered Mach-O images / 28 architecture slices still import none of the crc32_combine family. Exact first-party producer sources, Qt consumers, KSyntaxHighlighting and LibArchive contain no caller. Matches in bundled zlib/FreeType copies are implementation definitions and aliases, not calls into Apple libz.

The inspected Apple crc32_z internal x2nmodp call uses a nonnegative remaining-block count. crc32 takes an unsigned length. This narrows the observed crc32 imports but does not certify proprietary OS-framework internals or every supported native runtime.
F-APPLE.conclusion: No Apple runtime-fix claim is permitted from ABI 1.2.12 or absent *64 symbols. The timeout is a standalone library observation, not an application exploit. Keep the row pending until a complete supported-runtime/fix mapping or the required complete delivered-closure non-reachability proof exists. Updating Qt alone would not replace this OS-owned library.

import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/private/tmp/bpr-rfc0038-official-qt-20261016')
package = Path('/private/tmp/bpr-rfc0038-security-audit-20261016/macos-0.2.1-extracted/BetterPullReview.app')
frameworks = package / 'Contents/Frameworks'
plugins = package / 'Contents/PlugIns'
paths = [frameworks / 'QtWidgets.framework/Versions/A/QtWidgets', plugins / 'platforms/libqcocoa.dylib', plugins / 'styles/libqmacstyle.dylib', plugins / 'networkinformation/libqapplenetworkinformation.dylib', plugins / 'tls/libqsecuretransportbackend.dylib']
(root/'dbus_marker.c').write_text('int bpr_dbus_marker(void) { return 1; }\n')
records = []
for architecture in ('arm64', 'x86_64'):
    destination = root / ('loader-' + architecture)
    destination.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    marker = destination / 'libdbus-1.dylib'
    executable = destination / 'qt-dbus-load-probe'
    commands = [
        ['/usr/bin/clang','-arch',architecture,'-dynamiclib',str(root/'dbus_marker.c'),'-o',str(marker)],
        ['/usr/bin/clang','-arch',architecture,str(root/'qt_dbus_load_probe.c'),'-Wl,-rpath,'+str(frameworks),'-o',str(executable)],
    ]
    for command in commands:
        build = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
        assert build.returncode == 0, build.stderr
    command = [str(executable), *(str(p) for p in paths), str(marker)]
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15, env={'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin'})
    records.append({'architecture':architecture,'exitCode':result.returncode,'output':result.stdout.strip(),'error':result.stderr.strip()})
record = {
    'scope':'Exact packaged QtWidgets and all four shipped plugins loaded in a standalone process; no QApplication or window is constructed. This isolates automatic library initialization, not the complete application runtime. x86_64 executes through Rosetta.',
    'sourceSHA256':hashlib.sha256((root/'qt_dbus_load_probe.c').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'inputImages':[{'path':str(p.relative_to(package)), 'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in paths],
    'results':records,
}
(root/'qt-dbus-load-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(record,indent=2))
assert all(r['exitCode']==0 for r in records)

import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

out = Path('/private/tmp/bpr-rfc0038-official-qt-20261016')
repo = Path('/Users/jaeger/.codex/worktrees/rfc0038-security-audit/BetterPullReview')
old = Path('/private/tmp/bpr-rfc0038-independent-review-20261016')
qt = old / 'qt/qtbase-everywhere-src-6.11.2'
app = Path('/private/tmp/bpr-rfc0038-security-audit-20261016/macos-0.2.1-extracted/BetterPullReview.app')

def command(argv, expected=(0,)):
    p = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90)
    assert p.returncode in expected, (argv, p.returncode, p.stderr)
    return {'argv': argv, 'exitCode': p.returncode, 'matches': p.stdout.splitlines(), 'stderr': p.stderr}

record = {'scope': 'Source reference and packaged undefined-symbol audit; not an active GUI trace or proof about proprietary OS-framework internals.', 'sourceChecks': [], 'images': []}
for revision in ('c233c768327cd6c0cb6807860625ec12a9aeac14', '23447f3a9bacf9a080a93df18b1fb2f54f6ebd3d'):
    for pattern in ('crc32_combine', 'QDBus|dbus_connection|QDesktopUnixServices'):
        result = command(['git', 'grep', '-n', '-E', pattern, revision, '--', 'src'], (0, 1))
        assert not result['matches'], result
        record['sourceChecks'].append(result)

scopes = {
    'Qt application consumers': [str(qt/'src'), '-g', '!**/3rdparty/zlib/**', '-g', '!**/3rdparty/freetype/src/gzip/**'],
    'KSyntaxHighlighting': [str(old/'dependencies/syntax-highlighting-6.28.1/src')],
    'LibArchive': [str(old/'dependencies/libarchive-3.8.9/libarchive')],
}
for label, roots in scopes.items():
    result = command(['rg', '-n', '-g', '*.c', '-g', '*.cpp', '-g', '*.cc', '-g', '*.mm', 'crc32_combine', *roots], (0, 1))
    assert not result['matches'], result
    record['sourceChecks'].append({'scope':label, **result})

for directory in ('src/network', 'src/widgets', 'src/plugins/platforms/cocoa', 'src/plugins/styles/mac', 'src/plugins/networkinformation/apple', 'src/plugins/tls/securetransport'):
    assert (qt/directory).is_dir(), directory
    result = command(['rg', '-n', '-g', '*.c', '-g', '*.cpp', '-g', '*.cc', '-g', '*.mm', 'QDBus|dbus_connection|QDesktopUnixServices', str(qt/directory)], (0, 1))
    # Generic Unix network code is evaluated separately; all Cocoa/plugin/widget code must have no caller.
    if directory != 'src/network':
        assert not result['matches'], result
    record['sourceChecks'].append(result)

bound_paths = [
    'src/gui/CMakeLists.txt', 'src/gui/kernel/qguiapplication.cpp',
    'src/gui/platform/unix/qdesktopunixservices.cpp',
    'src/plugins/platforms/cocoa/qcocoaservices.h',
    'src/plugins/platforms/cocoa/qcocoaservices.mm',
    'src/plugins/platforms/cocoa/qcocoaintegration.mm',
    'src/dbus/qdbus_symbols.cpp', 'src/dbus/qdbusconnectionmanager.cpp',
    'src/3rdparty/freetype/src/gzip/crc32.c',
]
record['boundQtSources'] = [{'path':p, 'sha256':hashlib.sha256((qt/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in bound_paths]
previous = json.loads((old/'mac-imports.json').read_text())
for entry in previous:
    path = app/entry['name']
    digest = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert digest == entry['sha256']
    item = {'path':entry['name'], 'sha256':digest, 'architectures':{}}
    for arch in ('arm64', 'x86_64'):
        result = command(['/usr/bin/nm', '-arch', arch, '-u', str(path)])
        imports = result['matches']
        crc = [s.strip() for s in imports if 'crc32_combine' in s]
        dbus = [s.strip() for s in imports if 'DBus' in s or 'dbus_' in s]
        assert not crc, (path, arch, crc)
        item['architectures'][arch] = {'nmExit':result['exitCode'], 'crcCombineImports':crc, 'dbusImports':dbus}
    record['images'].append(item)
assert len(record['images']) == 14
(out/'remaining-source-paths.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'images':len(record['images']), 'slices':28, 'sourceChecks':len(record['sourceChecks']), 'dbusImportingImages':[x['path'] for x in record['images'] if any(a['dbusImports'] for a in x['architectures'].values())], 'networkDBusSourceMatches':[x['matches'] for x in record['sourceChecks'] if any(v.endswith('/src/network') for v in x['argv'])]}, indent=2))
